subject.title: [Bug]: Chrome MCP existing-session `profile=user` reports ready but all page tools time out on macOS

question: Should this remain open as a Chrome MCP `profile=user` page-tool bug, or should signed-in Chrome workflows be redirected to the new `chrome` extension profile instead?
rationale: Current source and release evidence show partial mitigations but not a root fix, and choosing between Chrome MCP repair, upstream escalation, or extension-profile guidance is a browser product/support boundary decision.

options.title: Keep open for live Chrome MCP repro
options.body: Capture a macOS Chrome 148+ trace for `status`, `tabs`, `snapshot`, `screenshot`, and `evaluate`, then decide whether the fix belongs in OpenClaw wrapper state handling or upstream Chrome DevTools MCP.

options.title: Redirect to extension profile
options.body: Treat the new `chrome` extension profile as the supported signed-in browser path and update docs/diagnostics so `profile=user` Chrome MCP limitations fail fast with clear guidance.

options.title: Track upstream only
options.body: Leave OpenClaw behavior unchanged except for diagnostics and route the root cause to Chrome DevTools MCP if live proof shows OpenClaw is only surfacing upstream timeouts.

recommendation.title: Keep open for live Chrome MCP repro
recommendation.body: Capture a macOS Chrome 148+ trace for `status`, `tabs`, `snapshot`, `screenshot`, and `evaluate`, then decide whether the fix belongs in OpenClaw wrapper state handling or upstream Chrome DevTools MCP.
